verdict.rationale: Knowledge ships its own agent tools (e.g. `knowledge_list`) and documents agents reading and updating pages in response to a request, so its content can be managed through natural-language instructions given to an agent. However, this depends on an agent the developer builds and wires up with those tools. There is no documented first-party natural-language command interface for operating the product, and Studio is a visual tree/graph UI. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command surface for users, documented coverage of operations beyond reading and writing pages (scopes, permissions, moves), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: For updates, the agent writes the page to the scope that matches the request.
With Knowledge, an agent can not only read information but update it too, allowing it to learn and self-improve over time.
`knowledge_list` lists the pages in a scope.
People and agents can add notes without rewriting the page.
